fullPassage: Long-distance hiking trails are becoming popular with more and more people. Let’s explore the appeal of long-distance hiking through a famous trail, the PCT. What Is the PCT? The PCT, or Pacific Crest Trail, is a 4,265-kilometer long hiking trail that stretches vertically across the U.S. Being so long, it crosses three states and seven national parks. Hikers can experience a varied range of landscapes, from hot desert regions to great mountain ranges. It takes about five months for the average person to walk through the trail, which is known as thru-hiking. “Thru-hikers” usually start in early spring and head north, arriving at their destination in early winter. It’s a hard journey with a low completion rate; just 14% of all hikers attempting a thru-hiking succeed in finishing the PCT. What Challenges Are There? In addition to the physical difficulties and mental isolation, surviving in nature for months itself can be a tremendous challenge. Hikers cook their own meals, and sometimes they have to endure days without eating. Securing water is another crucial requirement because not all the water sources are safe to drink. Hikers are advised to carry the latest PCT Water Report, a list of all water sources. When it comes to sleeping, most hikers sleep in tents, and in some areas, they can use shelters to stay safe from the harsh weather. If you are lucky, you may find “trail angels,” who provide transportation to close towns, meals, or other forms of assistance. Why Do They Bother? Hear from Finishers. • While the PCT was demanding, it was also a gift. It allowed me to see what I am truly capable of. • Traveling the PCT can be about the people you meet along the way. The trail has led to lasting friendships. • The PCT is a journey of a lifetime. It is a chance to see the magnificent landscapes of the American West.

questions.passage: Being so long, it crosses three states and seven national parks. Hikers can experience a (A)[varied / limited] range of landscapes, from hot desert regions to great mountain ranges. It takes about five months for the average person to walk through the trail, which is known as thru-hiking. “Thru-hikers” usually start in early spring and head north, arriving at their destination in early winter. It’s a (B)[hard / easy] journey with a low completion rate; just 14% of all hikers attempting a thru-hiking succeed in finishing the PCT. What Challenges Are There? In addition to the physical difficulties and mental isolation, surviving in nature for months itself can be a (C)[tremendous / minor] challenge.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① limited(제한된): 사막부터 산맥까지 '다양한' 풍경을 경험한다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② easy(쉬운): 완주율이 낮은 '힘든' 여정이라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ minor(사소한): 자연 속 생존이 '엄청난' 도전이라는 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ varied(다양한)+hard(힘든)+tremendous(엄청난): 다양한 풍경, 힘든 여정, 엄청난 도전이라는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
det.tip: varied range=다양한, hard journey=힘든 여정, tremendous challenge=엄청난 도전

questions.passage: In addition to the physical difficulties and mental isolation, surviving in nature for months itself can be a tremendous challenge. Hikers cook their own meals, and sometimes they have to (A)[endure / enjoy] days without eating. Securing water is another (B)[crucial / minor] requirement because not all the water sources are safe to drink. Hikers are advised to carry the latest PCT Water Report, a list of all water sources. When it comes to sleeping, most hikers sleep in tents, and in some areas, they can use shelters to stay safe from the (C)[harsh / mild] weather. If you are lucky, you may find “trail angels,” who provide transportation to close towns, meals, or other forms of assistance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① enjoy(즐기다): 먹지 못한 채 며칠을 '견뎌야' 한다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ② endure(견디다)+crucial(중요한)+harsh(혹독한): 굶주림을 견디고, 물 확보가 중요한 요건이며, 혹독한 날씨를 피한다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ③ minor(사소한): 물 확보가 또 다른 '중요한' 요건이라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ mild(온화한): 대피소로 '혹독한' 날씨를 피한다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: endure=견디다, crucial requirement=중요한 요건, harsh weather=혹독한 날씨

✅ ③ demanding(힘든)+lasting(지속되는)+magnificent(웅장한): 힘든 여정, 지속되는 우정, 웅장한 풍경이라는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ ordinary(평범한): 미국 서부의 '웅장한' 풍경을 본다는 문맥과 반대

❌ ② found nearby(근처에서 발견되는): 뒤에 물 보고서로 수원을 확인한다는 흐름과 어긋남
❌ ③ free of charge(무료인): 비용은 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ safe to drink(마시기에 안전한): 모든 수원이 '마시기에 안전한' 것은 아니어서 물 확보가 중요하다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: not all the water sources are safe to drink=모든 수원이 마시기에 안전한 것은 아니다

questions.passage: Hear from Finishers.  • While the PCT was demanding, it was also a gift.  It allowed me to see what I am truly capable of.  • Traveling the PCT can be about the people you meet along the way.  The trail has led to lasting friendships.  • The PCT is __________.  It is a chance to see the magnificent landscapes of the American West.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 a journey of a lifetime(일생일대의 여정)가 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① a journey of a lifetime(일생일대의 여정): 완주자들이 지속되는 우정과 웅장한 풍경을 언급하며 PCT를 극찬하는 긍정적 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ② a waste of money(돈 낭비): 완주자들의 긍정적 평가와 정반대
❌ ③ a boring routine(지루한 일상): 웅장한 풍경을 볼 기회라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ a short walk(짧은 산책): 4,265km에 이르는 여정과 맞지 않음
det.tip: a journey of a lifetime=일생일대의 여정
